sections.Profile:
As Sho, a ninja sworn to protect the Oni Sword, save the world from the evil Oni Nisshoku before he eclipses Japan with darkness from the Shadow Realm, fighting minions of darkness and rescuing the shrine maiden Akari along the way. Turner Pinball's first game, designed by Brad Duke, has eight boss battles drawn from Japanese mythology and a grappling hook kickback that turns a near-drain into a shot chain.
